verdicts.reason: Both moved the 'OBSIDIAN ONE' eyebrow below the body copy, which breaks the reading order. Both also cut the city skyline down to a thin strip at the bottom and leave a dead gap between the headphones and the CTA. A keeps the logo a readable size and aligned with the left text edge, but its headline sits only about 6px from the left edge. B leaves a little more margin, but it shrinks the logo to a tiny right-aligned mark off the text axis, which weakens the brand. B's CTA also nearly touches both side edges.
